description: This file defines a React functional component called TaskItem, which represents a single task in a to-do list application. It includes UI elements for displaying, editing, toggling completion, and deleting a task.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for the task, setting the draft to the current task title and focusing the input.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing mode, reverting any changes to the task title.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited task title if changed and exits editing mode.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keypress events during editing; saves on Enter and cancels on Escape.

ctags.name: TaskItem
ctags.pattern: /^export default function TaskItem({ task, onToggle, onUpdate, onDelete }) {$/

ctags.name: task
ctags.pattern: /^        aria-label={task.completed ? 'Mark as not completed' : 'Mark as completed'}$/

fields.name: aria-label={task.completed ? 'Mark as not completed' : 'Mark as completed'}
